driver.name: gams-fstats-hermite-values-derivatives-reference
driver.license: MIT (driver only; upstream package terms remain separate)
driver.modifications: Independent API consumer. Degree 1..5 global Hermite polynomials with values and supplied first derivatives at three irregular nodes; 33 queries each. Checks values and derivatives against explicit polynomial sums. This is global Hermite interpolation, not piecewise cubic; estimated derivatives excluded.

checks.oracle: independent sorted data, exact moments, Cartesian products or high precision distribution definitions
